records.name: Penn Band
records.summary: Penn's large student band, with close to a hundred members who play at Penn football and most basketball games. Members also travel to some away games and take part in campus events and community outreach.
records.what_you_do: Rehearse each week, play at games and campus events, and join social nights, road trips and section get-togethers. Members also get free seats at sports games.

schedule.text: Weekly rehearsals on Monday evenings (6 to 8 pm) and Wednesday evenings (8:30 to 10:30 pm) at the Platt Center

locations.label: Platt Student Performing Arts House
locations.address: Platt Student Performing Arts House, Penn campus

cost.text: Not stated on the pages checked; membership is described as all-inclusive

first_step.how: Come to the First Rehearsal or any Monday rehearsal, or fill out the interest form; no audition or application is needed
first_step.basis: The group says no audition, application or instrument test is needed, and that it is never too late to join

records.notes: The directory entry carries an inactive label and an application flag set to yes, but the group's own pages describe weekly rehearsals and say no audition is needed. The newest dated item is a 2025 agreement with no month, so the status is probably active rather than active. Member counts differ between the directory and the group's site.

schedule.text: Consulting projects and career programs run in the fall and spring semesters

cost.text: Not stated on the pages checked

first_step.basis: Project work needs an application, and the way in runs through a separate registration step

records.notes: Status rests on event names labeled 2026 on the group's site (a healthcare case competition and a biotech conference), with no months shown, so no sign of life month is recorded. The site describes its audience as graduate students, postdocs and Penn-affiliated researchers. Application deadlines on the site (September 11 and 16) carry no year.

records.what_you_do: Join optional practices and matches. The club runs a recreational team for beginners and a competitive women's team.

records.name: Penn Cycling

records.what_you_do: Join group rides and training through the club's group chat. The club also offers winter cross-training, and riders of all skill levels are welcome.

records.name: Penn for Youth Debate

schedule.text: Volunteer time is flexible, since the group works around each volunteer's schedule; first-meeting details are sent through the listserv

records.name: Penn Heroes

records.what_you_do: Undergraduates write historical research and submit it for publication, and can apply to join the journal's team when a call is open. Past issues are archived online.

schedule.text: Publishes twice a year, according to the directory listing

first_step.how: The last application deadline was January 29, 2023, so contact the journal to ask about the next call

records.name: Penn Leads the Vote
records.summary: A nonpartisan, student-run voter program open to the whole university. It helps people register, check their registration and get ready to vote, and it encourages year-round involvement in local, state and national issues.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer at registration tables and election events on campus, or apply for one of the program's paid jobs. Sign up for election reminders to hear about deadlines.

schedule.text: Runs registration tabling on Locust Walk around the 2026 election dates, including September 15, October 19 and November 3

notes: Searches: 0 (none allowed by brief). Fetches: 35 of 60 allowed. All 20 Penn Clubs entries were read through the directory endpoint and then, where the entry linked a working site, through one site fetch each. The fetch tool summarizes pages, so unclear application flags were recorded as unknown or as the nearest newcomer score, with the reason in basis. Verdicts: 18 publish, 2 hide (both Penn Carey Law clubs with no public way in, hidden as out_of_scope). Of the 18 publish verdicts, 2 are held back for missing summary, categories and interests as the brief directs: Penn Carey Law Tennis Club (directory says inactive, no website) and Penn for Refugee Empowerment (directory says inactive, no dated items). Two redirects were followed (Penn for Youth Debate domain to WordPress; Penn Band join page to the university groups site). Penn Dhamaka's audition year is inferred from a 2025 to 2026 season label. Penn International Impact Consulting's directory and recruiting page disagree on class years. Penn History Review is a university journal rather than a community group.
